_meta.indication: Treatment of the signs and symptoms of idiopathic Parkinson's disease as initial monotherapy and as adjunct therapy to levodopa

pivotal_trials.design: Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, parallel group; 26-week placebo-controlled treatment phase followed by a 26-week active-treatment phase
pivotal_trials.population: Early Parkinson's disease patients not treated with levodopa at enrollment
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline in the subtotal of UPDRS section III scores (ADL, Motor, and Mentation)
pivotal_trials.result: Mean UPDRS change was 0.06 for rasagiline 1 mg and 0.72 for 2 mg vs 3.91 for placebo (p=.0001 for both doses)

pivotal_trials.phase: Pivotal, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study (also included an active comparator of entacapone)
pivotal_trials.design: Double-blind, double-dummy, randomized, placebo- and entacapone-controlled, parallel group; 18-week double-blind treatment phase
pivotal_trials.population: Levodopa-treated Parkinson's disease patients with motor fluctuations on levodopa/peripheral dopa decarboxylase inhibitor therapy (adjunct to levodopa)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline in the mean total daily "Off" time from home diary
pivotal_trials.result: Change in daily "Off" time: -1.17 h for rasagiline 1 mg (p=.0001) and -1.19 h for entacapone (p=.0001) vs -0.35 h for placebo

pivotal_trials.design: Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, parallel group; 26-week double-blind treatment phase
pivotal_trials.population: Levodopa-treated Parkinson's disease patients experiencing motor fluctuations (adjunct to levodopa)
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Change from baseline in mean total daily "Off" time from home diary
pivotal_trials.result: Change in daily "Off" time: -1.85 h for rasagiline 1 mg (p=.0001) and -1.38 h for 0.5 mg (p=.0199) vs -0.88 h for placebo

key_safety: As monotherapy, most common AEs (≥5%, ≥1.5x placebo) were flu syndrome, arthralgia, depression, dyspepsia, and fall; e.g., arthralgia 7% vs 4%, flu syndrome 5% vs 1%. As adjunct to levodopa, dyskinesia 18% vs 10% placebo was most common. Serious class risks include hypertensive/tyramine reactions and drug interactions.
target_moa: Irreversible inhibitor of monoamine oxidase (MAO), inhibiting MAO type B, the major form in human brain that regulates metabolic degradation of catecholamines

summary.text: Standard NDA (505(b)) submitted September 5, 2003 and granted a Standard priority designation; after two Approvable Letters (7/2/2004 and 8/4/2005) addressing melanoma and tyramine concerns, it was approved on 5/16/2006 on the basis of three randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials (TEMPO monotherapy; LARGO and PRESTO adjunct to levodopa).

citations.quote: Please refer to your new drug application (NDA) dated and received September 5, 2003, submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for Azilect (rasagiline mesylate) 0.5mg and 1 mg Tablet
The Agency has issued two Approvable (AE) letters; one on 7/2/04, and a second on 8/4/05.
The application contained information of 3 pivotal, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled studies.

requirement.text: A formal tyramine challenge study in the fasted state (with positive control, multiple rasagiline dose levels, selegiline comparator)

citations.quote: A formal tyramine challenge study in the fasted state. This trial will incorporate the following elements:An appropriate number of subjects (e.g. approximately 20 per arm, equal number of males and females 40 to 70 years of age)

requirement.text: Investigate orthostatic blood pressure and pulse timed to rasagiline dosing, and conduct a thorough QTc study

citations.quote: To investigate orthostatic blood pressure and pulse timed to rasagiline dosing. This will be evaluated in both the tyramine challenge study listed above and the dose proportionality study listed below (no. 4).

requirement.text: Investigate dose-proportionality of daily doses of rasagiline (1, 2 and 6 mg) after multiple-dose administration in healthy young and elderly subjects and effect of levodopa/carbidopa on rasagiline PK

citations.quote: To investigate the dose-proportionality of daily doses of rasagiline (1, 2 and 6 mg) following multiple-dose administration in healthy young and elderly subjects and the effect of levodopa/carbidopa (single dose) on the pharmacokinetics of rasagiline (multiple dose).

requirement.text: Conduct a large, simple, randomized, placebo-controlled trial of rasagiline added to standard therapy in approximately 5000 Parkinson's disease patients for 36 months to assess relative risk of melanoma

citations.quote: 6. To conduct a large, simple, randomized, placebo controlled trial of rasagiline added to standard therapy in approximately 5000 Parkinson's disease patients for a duration of 36 months to assess the relative risk of melanoma.

requirement.text: Repeat the oral embryo-fetal development study in rabbits

citations.quote: 7. To repeat the oral embryo-fetal development study in rabbits. A draft audited report was supplied to Teva by the CRO on March 2, 2006 and is currently under review by Teva.

requirement.text: Investigate the effect of levodopa/carbidopa on rasagiline PK after multiple-dose administration, including age and gender effects

citations.quote: 9. To investigate the effect of levodopa/carbidopa on the pharmacokinetics of rasagiline following multiple-dose administration. This study should also investigate the age and gender effects on pharmacokinetics of rasagiline by enrolling adequate numbers of male and female subjects in different age groups.

basis.text: Instead of Complete Response Letters, two Approvable Letters were issued (7/2/2004 and 8/4/2005) raising concerns about melanoma signal and tyramine/hypertensive reaction potential
